confirm_back_reason: The agent explicitly summarized the quantity, price per unit, pickup time window, and payment terms, to which the buyer explicitly agreed before concluding the call.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Assalam-o-Alaikum Bhai! Main Fresh Mart Clifton se AI assistant bol raha hoon. Bhai, do minute milenge? Kaam ki baat hai.

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Walaikum Assalam bhai! Haan bolo, khairiat toh hai na? Mangoes ka koi scene hai toh rate aur mal batao jaldi se.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Humare paas 50 kilo Sindhri Mangoes hain, ripe hain aur skin thori spotted hai lekin andar se bilkul meethay aur juicy hain jo juice ke liye behtareen hain. Rate sirf Rs 180 per kilo hai, kya aap lena pasand karenge?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Bhai mal spotted hai toh rate thora munas

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Chalein, aap ke liye thora kam kar deta hoon, Rs 160 per kilo laga deta hoon kyunke market rate se pehle hi bohat kam hai. Kya yeh theek rahega aap ko?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Aray wah bhai, 160 rupay toh bilkul zabardast rate hai, sauda pakka samjhein! Main aaj shaam ko banda bhej kar cash de kar 50 kilo uthwa leta hoon.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Bhai, shaam ko nahi ho sakega kyunke pickup ka time 12 baje se 3 baje tak hi hai, 3 baje ke baad stock kisi aur ko nikal jayega. Kya aap banda 3 baje se pehle bhej sakte hain?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Chalo theek hai bhai, koi masla nahi, main do baje tak banda bhej kar cash pe 50 kilo uthwa leta hoon. Mal sambhal ke rakhna!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Toh Bhai, 50 kilo Sindhri Mangoes Rs 160 per kilo ke hisab se aap aaj 2 baje cash payment par Fresh Mart Clifton se collect karenge. 07 October, 3 baje aakhri deadline hai kyunke uske baad stock kisi aur ko offer kar diya jayega, kya aap yeh confirm karte hain?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Ji bilkul bhai, 100% confirm hai! Mera banda theek 2 baje cash le kar pohnch jayega, bas aap 50 kilo tayyar rakhna.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Chalein phir, sauda pakka! Maal aap ke liye alag rakh diya hai, aap ke bande ka 2 baje intezar rahega, Allah Hafiz!
